title: Traffic
subtitle: Rate, errors and duration for requests served through the ingress, with no app changes.

referrers.title: Top referrers
referrers.hint: Referring hosts only. Paths and query strings are never stored. Direct means no Referer header.
referrers.label: Referrer
referrers.empty: No referrer data in this window yet.

countries.title: Top countries
countries.hint: Coarse country from a CDN header or a GeoIP database, never stored per client.
countries.label: Country
countries.empty: No country data. Set a GeoIP database or a trusted country header on the ingress to see where traffic comes from.

markers.hint: Vertical lines mark deploys. Select one to see what changed.

slo.title: Error budget
slo.burnHint: 1.0x spends the budget exactly over the SLO period
slo.none: No SLO is set for this app. Add an SLO burn alert to see the error budget here.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.hint: Measured per upstream address at the ingress.
replicas.empty: No per replica data yet. It appears once requests reach a container through the ingress.

routes.title: Slowest routes
routes.hint: Slowest pages and API routes. Static files are left out.
routes.empty: No route has enough traffic in this window to rank.

kindHint.page: Pages people visit. Ids and query strings are never stored.
kindHint.api: API calls, grouped by route. Ids and query strings are never stored.
kindHint.asset: Static files such as scripts, styles and images. Counted separately so they do not bury your pages.

samples.title: Slow and failed requests
samples.hint: A sample of requests that failed or ran slow, kept on the node that served them.
samples.empty: No slow or failed requests were sampled in this window.

empty.title: No traffic in this window
empty.description: Requests show up here once the app is serving through a domain. Try a longer window or check that a domain points at this app.

shield.title: Bot and abuse shield
shield.none: Nothing was turned away in this window. Add per-client limits and a bot blocklist on the domain page to keep scrapers from running up bandwidth.

spikes.title: Error spikes
spikes.hint: Stretches where the server error share stood out from the rest of the window, matched to the deploy that started shortly before.
spikes.none: No error spikes in this window.
spikes.detail: {{errors}} of {{requests}} requests failed. Typical for this window: {{baseline}}.

abuse.title: Abuse defense
abuse.subtitle: Limit how fast one client can hit this app and turn away known bad addresses and agents. Start in log only to see what would be blocked.
abuse.loadError: Could not load the abuse defense: {{message}}

modeHints.log_only: Counts what would be blocked and blocks nothing.
modeHints.enforce: Turns matching requests away. Rate limits answer 429 with Retry-After.

abuse.suggestionFromPeak: Suggested from your peak of {{peak}} requests per second: {{rps}} per client, burst {{burst}}.
abuse.suggestionDefault: No recent traffic to size from. Suggested start: {{rps}} per client, burst {{burst}}.
abuse.requireUa: Turn away requests with no User-Agent
abuse.invalidNumber: Rate and burst must be numbers.
abuse.previewNeedsRule: Add a rate or a block list to preview its effect.
abuse.previewEmpty: No recent requests are held to replay yet, so there is nothing to preview.
abuse.previewResult: Would have blocked {{blocked}} of {{total}} recent requests ({{percent}}%)
abuse.enforceNeedsPreview: Enforcing unlocks once the preview above has loaded.
abuse.counters: Allowed {{allowed}}, would block {{wouldBlock}}, blocked {{blocked}} in this window.
abuse.failOpen_one: {{count}} request was served unchecked because the defense failed.
abuse.failOpen_other: {{count}} requests were served unchecked because the defense failed.

statusHint.NoRoutes: The app has no proxied route right now (stopped, asleep or a static site), so the policy has nothing to apply to.
statusHint.ClientIPHidden: A proxy in front hides visitor addresses, so every visitor would share one limit. Set the trusted proxies in the ingress settings.
